body:
BM Player works on Amazon Fire TV, Android TV boxes, Android phones, Windows PCs and Macs. You need a BM Support website account and an active subscription.

Link your device

  1. Open BM Player. After the opening video it shows a six-digit link code.
  2. On the BM Support website, open Link Device from the side menu and type the code and choose your app login. Your VPN must be off while linking.
  3. The player shows the family picture with Checking your linked device, then Go to home screen.

Using BM Player

  • Live TV: pick a category, then a channel. The guide shows what's on Now and Up next.
  • Sports Guide: shows event days only. Event channels list the event names at their start times.
  • Movies and Series: watched bars show your progress; choose Resume to carry on. Rate films and series with 1–5 stars.
  • Reminders: press the bell on a guide programme and confirm in the pop-up.
  • Favourites: saved favourites appear on every device you use.
  • Multi-screen: Multi Room and Triple Room accounts can watch 2 or 3 screens. Click or select a screen to move the sound to it.
  • Settings: rearrange categories, view your account info and connection count, and check for updates.

Household rules

Multi Room and Triple Room are for one home. One box can be used away from home, and only one mobile connection per account is allowed. A VPN is fine while watching.

Need help?

Raise a support ticket from the website during office hours and a member of staff will help.

body:
Install on Windows

  1. Open Install Guides and choose BM Player | Windows.
  2. Run the installer and open BM Player.

Install on Mac

  1. Choose BM Player | Mac and download the zip (Apple Silicon or Intel, macOS 12 or newer).
  2. Unzip it, move it to Applications, then right-click it and choose Open the first time.

Link your device

  1. Open BM Player. After the opening video it shows a six-digit link code.
  2. On the BM Support website, open Link Device from the side menu and type the code and choose your app login. Your VPN must be off while linking.
  3. The player shows the family picture with Checking your linked device, then Go to home screen.

Desktop tips

  • At start-up the app loads your full playlist and guide before you can move around — please wait for it to finish.
  • Settings › Stream format lets you choose Automatic, MPEG-TS or HLS.
  • Multi-screen on the home screen lets Multi Room and Triple Room accounts pick 2 or 3 screens.
